name: Squads USD
oneLiner: SQUSD is a dollar token issued on Solana through Bridge, with issuer-reported cash and Treasury reserves and no admitted market price.
collateral: Bridge reports dollar cash and a Treasury category that includes money-market funds with Treasury-bill ladders of less than three-month duration. The reported reserve total exceeds the listed category amounts; the difference remains unclassified. Named cash banks, fund allocations and an independent SQUSD reserve reconciliation were not retrieved.
pegMechanism: Bridge identifies SQUSD as a USD stablecoin issued on Solana. Dollar reserve and supply disclosures support the intended par backing; token-specific direct redemption eligibility, charges and settlement terms remain unverified.

proofOfReserves.provider: Bridge issuer dashboard and reserve JSON; no independently reconciled SQUSD reserve report retrieved

launchPhaseDetail: SQUSD is issued on Solana. The recorded launch date is the first positive mint returned in the reviewed on-chain history, rather than an independently documented commercial announcement. Bridge publishes current supply and reserve categories; no admitted price lane was found.

milestones.title: SQUSD issuance is recorded on Solana
milestones.description: A successful Token-2022 instruction mints 1,000 SQUSD at the Bridge-linked Solana mint. The recorded date anchors observed on-chain issuance.

listingStatusReview.reason: No admitted price lane: DefiLlama price is null, the exact-mint quote is empty, CoinGecko returns no asset, and DEX probes found no pools. DefiLlama supply and pinned Solana issuance are positive.
